items.title: Esther Dupuy Breckenridge Interview, 1958-05-14
items.q: Well, Miss Esther, he said, I've thought of you often, but I haven't seen you around, and I remember you and your sister harmonizing together.

ctx.x: Well, what did your parents' fans think of it? Did they universally like it, too?

They did. They did. Some of them were not as musical as my father. And... But they all condoned it. I mean, I don't have any recollection of any of them thinking it was... fresh. You know, they all... To my recollection, thought of it highly. Of course, we did, too. And I have... All your friends? Mm-hmm. As I say, we were a very dancing crowd. We sang and danced, and... Celestine was a hero to me. I mean, I can remember seeing him. I had been away a great deal, and I saw him about 12 years ago, and he hadn't…
Well, among your friends, back in the 20s, did most of them just think of something to go dance to and have a good time to it? Did any of them...
